### Preparing data 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(gt)
library(viridisLite)
library(terra)
library(geodata)
library(kableExtra)
```

### Loading in data
```{r}
# Load raster files 
feb_7_a <- read_stars(here('data', 'VNP46A1', 'VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif'))
feb_7_b <- read_stars(here('data', 'VNP46A1', 'VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif'))
feb_16_a <- read_stars(here('data', 'VNP46A1', 'VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif'))
feb_16_b <- read_stars(here('data', 'VNP46A1', 'VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif'))

# Create query objects 
road_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"

building_query <- "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type IN ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"

# Load in road data 
highway <- st_read(here('data', 'gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg'), query = road_query, quiet = TRUE)

# Load in building data 
buildings <- st_read(here('data', 'gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg'), query = building_query, quiet = TRUE)
```

### Check CRS 
```{r}
# Run conditional statement to check CRS
if (st_crs(buildings) == st_crs(highway)){
    print('CRS matches!')
}else{
    warning('CRS do not match!')
}

# Transform both CRS to 3083 
highway <- st_transform(highway, crs = 3083)
buildings <- st_transform(buildings, crs = 3083)

st_crs(highway) == st_crs(buildings)

```

### Blackout Mask
```{r}
# Combine both Feb 7th and Feb 16th days into one raster 
feb_7 <- st_mosaic(feb_7_a, feb_7_b)
feb_16 <- st_mosaic(feb_16_a, feb_16_b)

# Set extent of Houston
houston_extent <- st_bbox(
    c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
    crs = st_crs(feb_7)
)

# Crop data to Houston extent 
feb_7_houston <- st_crop(feb_7, houston_extent)
feb_16_houston <- st_crop(feb_16, houston_extent)

# Masking values
masked_feb_7 <- feb_7_houston
masked_feb_7[(masked_feb_7 > 1000) | (masked_feb_7 <= 0)] <- NA

masked_feb_16 <- feb_16_houston
masked_feb_16[(masked_feb_16 > 1000) | (masked_feb_16 <= 0)] <- NA

# Combine to use for light intensity map
both_days <- c(masked_feb_7, masked_feb_16)

# Calculate difference raster (subtract post-storm from pre-storm)
diff_raster <- rast(feb_16) - rast(feb_7)

# Reclassifying diff_raster 
rcl <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, 200, NA,
    200, Inf, 1,
    ncol = 3, 
    byrow = TRUE
))

# Apply reclassification to raster
rcl_diff <- classify(diff_raster, rcl = rcl)

# 

```

### Maps comparing night light intensities before and after the first two storms 

```{r}
# Change names for map title
names(both_days) <- c(
    'Pre-Storm (2-6-2021)',
    'Post-Storm (2-16-2021)'
)

# Map for light intensities before and after storm 
tm_shape(both_days) + 
    tm_raster(
        col.legend = tm_legend(
            title = 'Night Light Intensities',
            orientation = 'landscape'
        ),
        col.scale = tm_scale(values = 'rocket')
    ) + 
        tm_facets(ncol = 2, free.scales = FALSE) + 
        tm_graticules(
            col = 'white',
            lwd = 0.3, 
            alpha = 0.2,
            labels.size = 0.5,
            labels.pos = c('left', 'bottom'),
            n.x = 4, 
            n.y = 4
        )

```
